notes:
PSR B1508+55 (B1508+55): T:p1-b8 includes it among hyperfast neutron stars; T:p1-b11 cites the earlier proper-motion/parallax measurement and high speed, so I treat it as a follow-up to a previously identified hyperfast/unbound candidate. The supplied text does not give a separate numerical escape-speed threshold.
PSR B2224+65: T:p1-b8 explicitly includes it in the same hyperfast-NS group; no individual velocity or escape criterion is supplied, so inclusion rests on that group statement and the established 'hyperfast' (Galactic-unbound) interpretation; being presented as an example rather than a new discovery, it is treated as follow-up.
RX J0822−4300: T:p1-b8 includes it in the same hyperfast-NS group; no individual velocity or escape criterion is supplied, so its inclusion likewise rests on that explicit group statement and the established interpretation, and it is treated as follow-up.

PSR B1508+55: At T:p1-b11 the paper reports a high velocity of 1083^{+103}_{-90} km s^-1 for PSR B1508+55 from proper-motion and parallax measurements, but it does not identify this as the total three-dimensional speed in the Galactic rest frame; proper motion plus parallax gives a transverse speed. Therefore it is not assigned to galactic_rest_frame_velocity. The paper reports no numerical right ascension, declination, parallax, distance, proper-motion components, radial velocity, galactocentric radius, or bound/unbound probability for this star.

PSR B2224+65: PSR B2224+65 appears only in the abstract (T:p1-b8) as an example of a hyperfast neutron star, cited alongside PSR B1508+55 and RX J0822−4300. The paper provides no numerical values (position, distance, parallax, proper motion, radial velocity, or any other target quantity) for PSR B2224+65. The only measured velocity reported (1083_{-90}^{+103} km/s, T:p1-b11) pertains to PSR B1508+55, not the target. Accordingly, no quantities meeting the scientific rules can be extracted for the target star.

RX J0822−4300: The target star RX J0822−4300 is mentioned only in the abstract as an example of a hyperfast neutron star (T:p1-b8). The paper reports no positional, distance, parallax, proper-motion, radial-velocity, galactocentric, or bound-probability values for it. The only quantitative velocity in the text (1083^{+103}_{-90} km/s) refers to PSR B1508+55 (T:p1-b11), not the target, so no values are extracted.
